preregistration_revision.reason: A post-v1 simulation-free inspection found that the resumed C2 actor already has Adam state for all 20 actor parameters, including its two std-head parameters. The action-only invariant must therefore be exact preservation of the pre-existing std-head tensors and optimizer states, not an impossible zero state count.

objective: Repair the missing ordinary-reset APPROACH bridge in the monolithic C2 FlashSAC actor without changing reward, termination, observation, action, contact, clearance, grasp, or success semantics. Release a candidate to reverse curriculum only if correction-label fit improves on an episode-held-out DAgger split, the existing CLOSE/LIFT behavior is retained, and deterministic ordinary-reset physical grasp incidence improves.

causal_diagnosis.label_semantics: The stored action is the corrective oracle label evaluated on the logged learner/mixed-policy state. It is not an outcome claim and is never critic replay.

c2_actor_error_on_all_eligible_phase0_ro.interpretation: C2 does not reproduce the corrective APPROACH action on the states required by ordinary reset; the arm is the largest absolute error and the distal residual is badly nonzero despite a near-zero oracle target.

single_candidate_mechanism.actor_initialization: Exact full C2 checkpoint actor and optimizer.
single_candidate_mechanism.critic_and_replay_initialization: Exact full C2 checkpoint and replay resume with the same permanent transition demonstrations and demo fraction.
single_candidate_mechanism.actor_update: Exactly 250 scheduled actor slots are replaced by action-only behavior-cloning updates on phase 0. SAC actor and temperature updates are forbidden.
single_candidate_mechanism.actor_rehearsal_sources: The projected phase-0 rows from the three pinned successful transition demonstrations plus the new train-only DAgger correction projection.
single_candidate_mechanism.critic_update: The C2 critic and target continue for 500 updates on the exact resumed replay plus 250 vector steps of ordinary-reset online interaction. The critic is not used by deterministic release evaluations.

requirements: Extend ActorRehearsalSourceContract with a default-successful episode mode and an explicit correction-label mode.
Correction-label mode requires episode_success to be absent; all old and generic loaders retain successful-only behavior.
Add separate exact train and validation phase-0 contracts; only train joins the full-task training allowlist.
Add a deterministic no-clobber projection utility and simulation-free tests for split, lineage, phase, latch, fake-success and allowlist failures.
Add an offline actor panel evaluator that compares C2 and candidate on validation phase 0 and pinned successful transition-demo phases 1 and 3.
Run actor rehearsal, train contract, generator, offline evaluator and relevant bridge tests before simulator launch.
Commit and tag the implementation before copying/projecting data or launching Isaac.

execution_order.name: seal_implementation_and_project_data
execution_order.action: Complete simulation-free implementation/tests; commit and tag. Copy the byte-identical DAgger source to the canonical disk2 path, project train/validation once, and seal their SHA256/count manifest before Isaac evidence.

execution_order.name: training_scale_contact_preflight
execution_order.command_semantics: Run isgrasped_diag.py with the pinned rl_games actor and --require_object_contact.
execution_order.gate: At 1024 environments the singleton object-filtered contact tensor has the expected [1024,1,3] family shape for every fingertip and at least one force exceeds the task threshold. Failure stops before baseline or training.

execution_order.name: sealed_c2_baselines
execution_order.rule: Both baselines are immutable after creation. Candidate evaluations use the same seeds, widths, quotas, horizon, task and curriculum bytes in fresh processes.

execution_order.name: offline_release_gate

held_out_phase0.panel: All 54900 validation rows, never sampled by the optimizer.

successful_transition_retention.panel: All phase-1 and phase-3 rows from the three pinned strict-success transition demonstrations.

execution_order.failure_action: Reject Candidate44 before candidate physical evaluation; do not tune thresholds, add updates, inspect reserved seeds, or call the failed actor a bootstrap.

execution_order.name: paired_physical_release_gate
execution_order.decision_if_pass: Candidate44 establishes a useful monolithic ordinary-reset approach bridge. Seal the result and create a new preregistered reverse-curriculum Candidate45 starting close to probability 1; no reverse-curriculum run is authorized by this plan.
execution_order.decision_if_fail: Reject Candidate44 and retain exact C2. Diagnose whether held-out action imitation failed to transfer physically or overwrote the close/lift basin; do not silently extend training.

interpretation_limits: Passing offline correction metrics alone is not evidence of grasping or lifting.
Passing ordinary ever-grasped is evidence for the approach-to-grasp bridge, not yet 20 cm end-to-end success.
Only strict task success with true convex-hull clearance at least 20 cm may be called successful lift.
Candidate44 does not test entropy exploration from scratch; it tests whether FlashSAC can preserve C2 off-policy state while repairing a missing actor phase from DAgger correction labels.
No result from Candidate43 enters Candidate44 estimators.
